verdict.rationale: Qualcomm publishes memory bandwidth (228 GB/s LPDDR5x) and NPU TOPS figures plus an AI SDK/toolkit for deploying models to the NPU, but the vendor page explicitly does not publish a max memory capacity figure, leaving unclear whether the platform can even address enough RAM for a 70B-class quantized model. No benchmarks or community reports confirm actual large-model local inference performance; community reaction is skeptical of the bandwidth claims and no independent reviews exist yet (product not shipping until 2026). missing for 10: published max RAM/memory capacity, real-world 70B-class inference benchmarks, independent hands-on corroboration.
